one_liner: Butterfly Swarm V5 creates a dynamic swarm of animated butterflies with configurable amount, scale, flap and fly speeds, using a GLB model and client‑side animation.
primary_use_case: Add a visually appealing, customizable butterfly swarm to a Hyperfy world for ambient animation.
preview_recommendation: Add a short looping video or GIF of the butterfly swarm for preview; otherwise the app will show a placeholder.
